mapper.select: SELECT A.USER_ID, A.USER_NAME, A.USE_YN, A.OFFICE_CODE, D.OFFICE_NAME, A.HP_NO, A.AUTH_CODE, A.USERGROUP_ID, C.USERGROUP_NM AS USERGROUP_NM, A.WORK_GROUP_ID, dbo.getCode_nm(A.WORK_GROUP_ID) as WORK_GROUP_NM, A.MGMCOMP_CODE, B.MGMCOMP_CODE AS MGMCOMP_NM, CASE WHEN D.STATUS = '104003' OR A.STATUS = '100003' THEN '9' ELSE '0' END AS STATUS, dbo.getCode_nm(A.STATUS) as STATUS_NM, A.MGM_CODE, A.UP_MGMUSER_ID, A.LEVEL_CODE, A.UP_MGMUSER_NAME, C.GROUP_GBN, ISNULL(D.TEL,E.TEL) AS TEL, ISNULL(ISNULL(D.COMP_CODE, A.COMP_CODE), E.COMP_CODE) AS COMP_CODE, E.COMP_NAME, A.EMP_NO FROM TPM_USER A LEFT JOIN TPM_MGM_COMPANY B ON A.MGMCOMP_CODE = B.MGMCOMP_CODE LEFT JOIN TPM_MGTGROUP C ON A.USERGROUP_ID = C.USERGROUP_ID LEFT JOIN TPM_OFFICE D ON A.OFFICE_CODE = D.OFFICE_CODE LEFT JOIN TPM_COMPANY E ON D.COMP_CODE = E.COMP_CODE WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.USER_ID = #{userId} AND A.PASSWD = #{password} AND ISNULL(D.STATUS,'') NOT IN ('104002','104003')

SELECT A.OFFICE_CODE AS OFFICE_CODE, A.OFFICE_NAME AS OFFICE_NAME, A.TEL AS TEL, B.CONT_KIND_CD AS CONT_KIND_CD, dbo.getCode_nm(B.CONT_KIND_CD) AS CONT_KIND_NM FROM dbo.TPM_OFFICE A LEFT JOIN dbo.TPM_CONTRACT B ON A.OFFICE_CODE = B.OFFICE_CODE
AND A.OFFICE_NAME LIKE '%' + #{OFFICE_NAME} + '%'

SELECT A.USER_ID, A.USER_NAME, A.USE_YN, A.HP_NO, A.AUTH_CODE, B.OFFICE_CODE, B.OFFICE_NAME, A.USERGROUP_ID, C.USERGROUP_NM AS USERGROUP_NM, A.WORK_GROUP_ID, dbo.getCode_nm(A.WORK_GROUP_ID) as WORK_GROUP_NM, B.MGMCOMP_CODE, B.MGMCOMP_CODE AS MGMCOMP_NM, CASE WHEN B.STATUS = '104003' OR A.STATUS = '100003' THEN '9' ELSE '0' END AS STATUS, dbo.getCode_nm(A.STATUS) as STATUS_NM, A.MGM_CODE, A.UP_MGMUSER_ID, A.LEVEL_CODE, A.UP_MGMUSER_NAME, C.GROUP_GBN, ISNULL(B.TEL,E.TEL) AS TEL, ISNULL(ISNULL(B.COMP_CODE, A.COMP_CODE), E.COMP_CODE) AS COMP_CODE, E.COMP_NAME, A.EMP_NO FROM TPM_USER A JOIN TPM_OFFICE B ON B.OFFICE_CODE = #{OFFICE_CODE}
LEFT JOIN TPM_MGM_COMPANY D ON B.MGMCOMP_CODE = D.MGMCOMP_CODE LEFT JOIN TPM_MGTGROUP C ON A.USERGROUP_ID = C.USERGROUP_ID LEFT JOIN TPM_COMPANY E ON B.COMP_CODE = E.COMP_CODE WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.USER_ID = #{userId} AND A.PASSWD = #{password} AND ISNULL(B.STATUS,'') NOT IN ('104002','104003')
